notes: Five alternating-order rounds on a shared host; no concurrent builds or broad test jobs owned by this experiment. Other host activity was uncontrolled.
JIT runtime cache primed; default compiler optimization. AOT build time was not measured.
All outputs/checksums agreed across CPython, baseline and candidate in both modes.
candidate_commit is the local implementation commit; implementation_sha256 identifies the measured matcher independently of publication metadata.
Timed pyperformance workloads include any in-loop lazy initialization/cache misses. Whole-process time additionally includes setup, checksums, startup and JIT compilation.
repeat uses 1000 loops and the process CPU clock; each process reports the median of three warmed samples per case.
